## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Added/updated tests (regression test for bug fixes)
- [ ] Comments and docs are in English
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the [DCO](../blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco)
